definitions.explanation: The act of maintaining order, enforcing rules, or supervising to ensure compliance with laws or regulations.
Intensified enforcement activity, especially by police or authorities against violations.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{取|と}り{締|し}まる→取り締まる：06163_torishimaru⟧ (to control, supervise) → noun form {取|と}り{締|し}まり

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取|と}り{締|し}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ - to conduct enforcement
- {取|と}り{締|し}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}する→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧ - to intensify crackdowns
- {取|と}り{締|し}まり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧ - enforcement is strict
- {取|と}り{締|し}まり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧ - to get caught in a crackdown
- {取|と}り{締|し}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}れる→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧ - to escape enforcement

TYPES OF {取|と}り{締|し}まり:
- ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧{取|と}り{締|し}まり - traffic enforcement
- ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧{取|と}り{締|し}まり - speed enforcement
- ⟦{不法投棄|ふほうとうき}→不法投棄：18933_fuhoutouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{締|し}まり - crackdown on illegal dumping
